annotation: The participant raised the hands in front of their chest, curled the fingers, moved the right hand forward, then dropped them down a little bit, swung the right hand to the right side
The participant nodded the head continuously and laughed gently
The participant touched the eyebrows with the right hand, then placed the hands in front of the chests, slightly moved them back and forth, with the palms facing the chests
The participant placed the hands in parallel and diagonal lines, moved the left hand down and sliced the right hand in the diagonal line from right to left,
